description: Zero-shot transfer test: UMN-trained pipeline (unmodified, no fine-tuning) run on https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aj1714/crowd-panic-dataset. Rank-order comparison only -- AUROC deliberately not computed, see module docstring.

supplementary_analysis.note_on_mean_vs_median: Distributions are heavy-tailed (most clips near-zero, some near 1.0), so median/IQR is less outlier-sensitive than the primary mean+/-std table above. Median ordering: Normal (0.002) approx Crowdy (0.002) < No Panic (0.016) << Panic (0.152) -- the non-panic classes do NOT order monotonically by apparent density (No Panic scores higher than both Normal and Crowdy), only the panic/non-panic split is clean.

panic_vs_pooled_nonpanic.test_description: Mann-Whitney U, one-sided (panic > pooled non-panic), on per-clip mean k=0 risk scores. This is the cleanest positive result in this transfer test: the coarse panic/non-panic split is statistically significant and large, even though the finer 4-way class ordering (see note_on_mean_vs_median) is not monotonic.
